newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-DO OR DIE TIME FOR AC MILAN AGAINST GOTHENBURG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DO OR DIE TIME FOR AC MILAN AGAINST GOTHENBURG.

text.p: Italian champions AC Milan find themselves in the unusual position of having to play for Champions League survival when they face IFK Gothenburg in a Wednesday Group D tie on Wednesday.
Halfway through the qualifying stage, Milan have already lost two out of three, to Portugese side Porto and by Gothenburg a fortnight ago.
They have just three points, level with Norwegian side Rosenborg and Gothenburg but six behind Porto.
Milan's problems in the Champions League have been reflected in the Italian serie A where they have lost three times, most recently 1-0 to Fiorentina on Sunday.
Their Croat midfielder, Zvonimir Boban, has no illusions about the do-or-die nature of Milan's task against Gothenburg.
"This is a match of a lifetime for us, we've got to win it in order to stay in the Champions League," he said on Tuesday.
The team's Liberian striker George Weah believes the team's current problems are more mental than physical.
"Last year we won games 1-0 or held on for a 0-0 draw. This year, if we're in front, our opponents overhaul us and if we're drawing 0-0 like against Fiorentina, then we lose.
"It's a question of our minds, concentration. We've got to be more attentive and not be caught out," he said.
On the eve of the match, Milan received a boost that influential midfielder Demetrio Albertini will be fit to play.
His return partly compensates for the injury enforced absence of key players like Montenegrin Dejan Savicevic and captain Franco Baresi.
Albertini returns to midfield alongside Boban with Dutchman Edgar Davids on the left and with either Tomas Locatelli or Stefano Eranio on the right.
Milan will field their customary 4-4-2 formation with the attack being led by Liberian George Weah and Marco Simone, thus once again relegating Roberto Baggio to the subs bench.
Frenchman Marcel Desailly replaces Baresi, dropping back from midfield to partner Alessandro Costacurta in defence.
Gothenburg come into the game on a high having picked up their fourth consecutive Swedish league title last weekend.
Further good news for the Swedes came with confirmation this week that 22-year-old midfielder Jesper Blomqvist has signed a new contract with the club.
Blomqvist is one of the emerging talents of Swedish soccer and his name had been linked to a number of European sides.
He will probably be partnered by Niclas Alexandersson, Magnus Erlingmark and Stefan Lindqvist in a four-man midfield.
Andreas Andersson, top scorer in the Swedish league with 19 goals, leads the attack along with experienced former Ajax Amsterdam striker Stefan Pettersson.
Probable teams:
AC Milan - Sebastiano Rossi, Christian Panucci, Alessandro Costacurta, Marcel Desailly, Paolo Maldini; Tomas Locatelli, Demetrio Albertini, Zvonimir Boban, Edgar Davids; George Weah, Marco Simone.

IFK Gothenburg - Thomas Ravelli, Stefan Landberg, Jonas Olsson, Teddy Lucic, Mikael Nilsson; Niclas Alexandersson, Magnus Erlingmark, Stefan Lindqvist, Jesper Blomqvist; Andreas Andersson, Stefan Pettersson.
